Rooftop Hideaway
Nov 2019 • Solo
This is a hidden away rooftop gem. To access you near to enter the bank doors and lobby area and then take a lift. You can see the restaurant on the top of the building and there was signage on the street. Welcoming and friendly staff but with limited English. The restaurant is ( comfortably) split between and indoor and greener outdoor areas. The ambiance is relaxed and gardensque with an a BU dance of greenery both inside and out; the food is unfussy, homely and very good. Limited drinks options, but sufficient enough range to satisfy a causal diner. Very good value.

Special Rooftop Treat
Oct 2019
This is a really beautiful restaurant with great service and delicious food. I especially liked the decor which sort of felt traditional even through it's at the top of a modern building. And, you can see the famous building from which the last evacuation helicopters departed with US evacuees from Saigon in 1975. 

There are tons of really great options - for both vegetarians and non. Honestly, this place was the best treat of my whole time in Ho Chi Minh City.

Great service and a variety of vegetarian options
Aug 2019
This is a lovely rooftop restaurant, with the outside space adorned with plants and shrubs. The staff were welcoming and friendly and were happy to provide suggestions. My boyfriend and I are both vegetarians and we had a hard time choosing between all the delicious-sounding options. We tried a few different dishes and really enjoyed them all. We ended up being the only ones in the restaurant so the food arrived quickly.
The only minor downside is the cocktails were small, but they were very tasty!
We will definitely be coming back.
